question: How does this wheel expand across different orders of manifestation?
premises: The wheel operates by the force of sequence and nonsequence.
It appears in twos, threes, and many other groupings.
It expands through various orders while devouring object, measure, and subject.
inference: The same wheel unfolds in multiple ordered and nonordered configurations and encompasses all poles of cognition.
uncertainties: The exact technical mapping of the twofold and threefold groupings is not specified here.
plain_english: By the power of sequence and nonsequence, this arisen wheel expands in twos, in threes, and in many other ways, through various orders, devouring the object, the measure, and the subject.
